subject: Access ops kickoff: FinSecure SSO/SCIM and onboarding controls
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Frank Liu <frank.liu@finsecure.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access ops kickoff: FinSecure SSO/SCIM and onboarding controls

Hi Frank / Priya,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get FinSecure live. I'm owning the onboarding coordination from the CS/sales side and looping in Laura (implementation lead) and Monica (customer success). Neha is on the security eval as a backup for policy questions.

Scope for this thread: get us SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, IP allowlist for outbound requests, and the initial service-account permissions & org policy expectations so we can schedule a staging test. Key asks below so we can hit a deployment window next week: 

1) SAML metadata: IdP metadata URL or metadata XML file (entityID, ACS, certificate).
2) SCIM admin: SCIM base URL and an admin token or OAuth client (we prefer a scoped token).
3) IP allowlist: list of IPs we need to open for callbacks and healthchecks (both directions) and any proxy in front of SCIM.
4) Service account: please confirm if you can create a dedicated service account for Redwood (suggested name: redwood-scim-bot@finsecure.com) with the minimal scope to manage users & groups.
5) Org policies: required session timeout, enforced SSO/MFA for admins, and any device restrictions we should mirror in our staging role matrix.
6) Compliance artifacts: if you have an internal SOC report or the contact for security questionnaire follow-up, share here.

Proposed timeline: gather artifacts by EOD Thu (Oct 22), configure and smoke-test in staging Oct 22 afternoon (2–4pm PDT), and plan production cutover the following week after sign-off. If that window doesn't work, flag alternatives.

I've attached our onboarding checklist and sample role mapping doc to illustrate the minimums.

Next steps: Frank/Priya — please confirm you can provide items 1–5 and whether the Oct 22 staging slot works. Laura/Monica/Neha — please review the checklist and call out any Redwood-side pre-reqs we should meet before staging.

Thanks,

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0138
Redwood Inference

From: Frank Liu <frank.liu@finsecure.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finsecure.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access ops kickoff: FinSecure SSO/SCIM and onboarding controls

Ben — thanks, and glad to kick this off. A few quick items below and I uploaded the SAML metadata and a short-lived SCIM token to the shared folder (see attachments).

- SAML metadata: hosted at https://idp.finsecure.com/metadata.xml (I also attached finsecure_saml_metadata.xml).
- SCIM: we created a token for initial testing (attached as finsecure_scim_token.txt). This token will expire; for production we plan to provide an OAuth client with client_id/client_secret.
- IP allowlist: our outbound IPs for callbacks are 34.82.12.45 and 34.82.12.46 (we're behind a CDN but these are the egress addresses for SAML assertions). For SCIM inbound calls, please expect connections from Redwood's service IPs (we'll accept a CIDR).
- Service account: we can create redwood-scim-bot@finsecure.com with the Users:ReadWrite and Groups:ReadWrite scopes. Security requires that the account be non-interactive and have MFA disabled for system accounts.
- Org policies: currently enforced: MFA required for admin role, session timeout 8 hours, and device checks for contractor accounts. We can relax the session timeout for integration service accounts.

We are good for the Oct 22 slot (2–4pm PDT) for staging tests. I'll ask Priya to confirm the service-account creation and the drive link for the onboarding artifacts.

Attaching: finsecure_saml_metadata.xml, finsecure_scim_token.txt

Regards,
Frank
Director, IT Ops
FinSecure

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Frank Liu <frank.liu@finsecure.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finsecure.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access ops kickoff: FinSecure SSO/SCIM and onboarding controls

Frank — appreciate the quick turnaround and the artifacts. Quick clarifications so the implementation team can proceed without blockers:

- SCIM token: can you confirm the token type (Bearer) and the base URL for the SCIM endpoint (e.g., https://scim.finsecure.com/v2/)? Laura's team will need to set the provisioning base path.
- IPs: thanks for the egress list. For Redwood's CIDR, we'll provide the list of expected source addresses for the SCIM calls — please confirm you can add a CIDR instead of individual IPs if that's easier.
- Service account scope: Users:ReadWrite and Groups:ReadWrite is fine. For least privilege, we'll only call the endpoints required during provisioning. Please confirm that the service account will be permitted to read group memberships for role mapping.
- Org policies: noted on session timeout and MFA. Please confirm whether you require SAML attribute mappings for role assignment (e.g., groups -> app_role). If so, provide the attribute name used for groups in assertions.

Action items for Redwood (Laura): prepare a staging config (SAML entry, SCIM token header), provide the exact source IPs, and a short test plan for Oct 22 (user create, password sync disabled, group sync, deprovision).

Laura/Monica — can you confirm the staging test checklist and that we have console access to a FinSecure staging org? If not, we need a sandbox account credential with admin rights (expires after test).

Thanks — will prep the staging plan and send a calendar invite for the 2–4pm slot pending confirmations.

--
Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Frank Liu <frank.liu@finsecure.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access ops kickoff: FinSecure SSO/SCIM and onboarding controls

Hi all — technical notes from the implementation side. We're aligned with Ben's checklist and will take the lead on the following items:

1) SCIM details we need from FinSecure:
   - SCIM base URL (full path, e.g., https://scim.finsecure.com/v2/)
   - Token scheme (Bearer) and whether token needs a prefix.
   - If using OAuth, please provide client_id and a transient client_secret (we will rotate secrets after provisioning).

2) SAML: we'll ingest the metadata XML. If FinSecure sends groups as an attribute, please confirm the attribute name (e.g., memberOf or groups) and whether it is a list of strings. Example mapping we recommend: 
   - groups -> Redwood role mapping: group_name="eng-admin" -> app_role=admin; group_name="eng-user" -> app_role=user

3) Service account: creating redwood-scim-bot@finsecure.com is preferred. Please ensure the account is set as non-interactive. Minimum permissions: Users:ReadWrite, Groups:ReadWrite. We do not need org-wide admin.

4) IP allowlist: if you can add a CIDR for Redwood's connectors that will simplify repeated changes. We'll send our connector CIDRs in the next email.

5) Staging test plan (we will perform the following in the 2–4pm window):
   - CREATE: create test user (scim-test-user+001@finsecure.com) and verify attributes (email, displayName).
   - GROUP SYNC: create a test group, add users, verify group membership mapping.
   - UPDATE: modify an attribute (title, manager) and confirm SCIM PATCH reflects change.
   - DEPROVISION: disable user and verify provisioning state and no access in SSO flow.

6) Rollback: if any provisioning call causes unexpected user lockouts, we will disable the connector and provide a remediation script to re-enable users.

Sample headers we will send for SCIM (for firewall rules):
   - Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>
   - Content-Type: application/scim+json

If FinSecure can provide a staging admin account (time-bound), that will avoid us needing to create test users in production. Otherwise we will perform all work in a dedicated sandbox org.

I'll attach a small sample mapping file and the staging runbook to the Drive link Ben included.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finsecure.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Frank Liu <frank.liu@finsecure.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access ops kickoff: FinSecure SSO/SCIM and onboarding controls

Thanks everyone — confirming the staging window (Oct 22, 2–4pm PDT). A few items from our side: 

- Service account: created "redwood-scim-bot@finsecure.com" and I've granted Users:ReadWrite and Groups:ReadWrite. Non-interactive flag is set.
- SCIM base URL: https://scim.finsecure.com/v2/ (token is Bearer and the token in finsecure_scim_token.txt works for staging).
- SAML groups attribute: we send groups in the assertion under attribute name "memberOf" as a semicolon-delimited string.
- Redwood CIDR allowed: 34.120.128.0/22 (please confirm you see traffic from this range during the test).
- Staging admin access: created a time-bound admin user for Redwood (expires Oct 23 23:59 PDT). Credentials are in the secure drive link: https://drive.finsecure.com/shared/redwood-staging-creds (Priya: do not copy creds to email body).

We also uploaded an internal checklist and the initial security questionnaire answers to the Drive. If you need a SOC contact, email security@finsecure.com and they will respond within 24 hours.

Looking forward to the test — please send the calendar invite and the Redwood-side CIDR you referenced.

Best,
Priya Shah
IT Systems Lead, FinSecure
